customManagers.description: Cua Spaces has no apt repository: its release is pinned in the host play.

packageRules.description: Patch, minor and digest bumps merge themselves on green CI; majors keep the owner hold (fleet-ops#11920). Renovate Docs, "Automerge": automerge plus platformAutomerge uses GitHub's own merge queue. The only bump here is the cua-spaces release line in ansible/host.yml, so a bump never edits auth, billing or migration code.
A Postgres major needs a dump and restore, not an Image= bump.
A Cua Spaces release is taken only once it is 3 days old, as the old daily update did.
